items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: this fellow that played a trombone, and was just about tit for tat for Dorsey, man, for singing the trombone. And you know how Dorsey can make a trombone sing.

ctx.x: Yes, uh-huh. And, you know, it's a funny thing about one of the programs that I played. I'll tell you something funny. I played a Jewish old folks' home, and
I had a trombone player -- this fellow that played a trombone, and was just about tit for tat for Dorsey, man, for singing the trombone. And you know how Dorsey can make a trombone sing.
